Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. About the Role: CrowdStrike’s Counter Adversary Operations (CAO) Elite is looking for a highly motivated, self-driven, detailed-oriented, and experienced Senior Analyst dedicated to making a difference in global security by protecting organizations against the most advanced attackers in the world. This role demands a solutions-oriented mindset, as you'll be expected to go above and beyond for this customer by driving innovative outcomes. You'll collaborate across multiple CrowdStrike teams to craft creative solutions, ensuring we exceed customer expectations and deliver exceptional value. You will leverage CrowdStrike CAO's extensive resources to provide advanced threat hunting expertise and intelligence analysis to safeguard our customers' environments. You will develop a trusted partnership by helping your customer identify and operationalize timely, actionable, and relevant threat intelligence and threat hunt findings. This position offers exceptional growth opportunities, blending technical mastery with strategic advisory services, all powered by CrowdStrike's world-class intelligence and hunting capabilities. After a period of learning our custom-built tool suite, workflows, and methodologies you will join other CAO Elite Analysts protecting our customer's networks by performing tailored threat hunting and customer specific threat intelligence operations, including: Executing sophisticated threat hunting operations Providing high value, actionable, threat intelligence aligned to the customer's requirements using your expertise and knowledge of the threat landscape Delivering high-impact briefings and recommendations spanning threat hunting, dark web, and intelligence information relevant to your customer Responding to customers’ ad hoc requests for information and support Building lasting partnerships with customers As you grow in the role you will have opportunities to undertake research, improve our threat hunting service, develop specialized intelligence knowledge, and work with other CrowdStrike teams across a broad range of topics and projects. Am I a CAO Elite Analyst? Are you passionate about threat hunting, threat intelligence, and dark web monitoring? Do you love working with customers and interacting with stakeholders from SOC analysts to CISOs? Are you a skilled communicator who enjoys crafting and delivering targeted presentations? Do you crave new and innovative work that leads the way? What You’ll Do: Maintain ownership of dedicated customer account, , facilitate high levels of customer satisfaction, and be a trusted advisor for CAO Elite customer’s internal teams Perform threat hunting, research dark web data, and research tailored threat intelligence for CAO Elite customer based on their specific requirements and environment Prepare and deliver customer presentations relating to intelligence reports, dark web alerts, and threat hunting findings on a regular basis Partner across CrowdStrike teams to develop and implement creative solutions that exceed customer expectations, focusing on delivering exceptional outcomes even when faced with complex challenges Respond to customer requests relating to threat intelligence, threat hunting, and dark web monitoring What You’ll Need: All candidates must possess the following qualifications: 5+ years of experience in two (or more) of the following areas: Incident response or security operations Threat hunting Cyber Threat intelligence Dark web monitoring Exemplary organizational skills with the ability to communicate both executive and detailed level findings to clients; ability to effectively communicate tasks, guidance, and methodology with internal teams. Embodies our core value of being "Fanatical about the customer" by implementing solution-oriented approaches that transform challenges into positive security outcomes Team-First Mindset: Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively within a customer-focused team environment, sharing knowledge and supporting colleagues while maintaining strong individual accountability for assigned deliverables. Presentation Delivery: a background in presenting, briefing, and delivering reports to stakeholders ranging from individual contributors to executives. Incident Handling: experience conducting threat hunting or managing incident response for organizations, investigating targeted threats such as the Advanced Persistent Threat, Organized Crime, and Hacktivists. Intelligence Tradecraft: knowledge of cyber threat intelligence terminology and data communication concepts and technologies. Enterprise SaaS & Cloud Security: Technical understanding of security across multiple cloud environments (production, development, isolated workspaces) with specific knowledge of enterprise SaaS platforms, their interconnected ecosystems, and unique security vulnerabilities. Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes. Security Control Validation - Experience validating prevention and detection capabilities against complex attacks using the MITRE ATT&CK framework, security validation methodologies, and automated testing approaches. Ability to travel on short notice, up to 5% of the time. title: Jr. Quality Systems Specialist
jd_text: POSITION OVERVIEW: The Jr. Quality Systems Specialist (JQSS) is responsible for assisting with the implementation and/or usage of assigned internal or external software applications. The JQSS is also responsible for the collection and distribution of data from these systems. KEY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: Perform and document internal audits of existing quality systems and technologies to ensure adherence to regulatory policies and internal guidelines. Identify opportunities for process improvement within quality systems and contribute to developing strategies to enhance efficiency and quality. Complete quality-related transactions, maintain accurate records of inspections and tests, and compile and report on quality data and system performance. Assist in managing key quality system elements, inclusive of Cumulus “Smart Torque” torque management software, Go Canvas, LN, iMonnit Welding Consumable monitoring software, and Intellect. Providing exported data out of each application in a manner that can be used to evaluate business conditions. Making sure software programs continue to work properly after maintenance and testing. Develop business cases for new software applications that best suit the current and future goals of the quality department and departments connected to those processes. This role partners closely with executive leadership, operations, project management, and accounting teams to drive profitability, improve financial performance, strengthen internal controls, and support strategic decision-making. This position reports to the Vice President of Finance. Principal Duties and Responsibilities Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual financial planning and forecasting processes. Analyze financial results and provide actionable recommendations to executive leadership. Develop financial models to support strategic initiatives, capital investments, and operational decisions. Monitor key financial and operational performance indicators and communicate results to leadership. Partner with Operations, Project Executives, Project Managers, and Project Accountants to monitor project financial performance. Support month-end and year-end close, audit preparation, GAAP compliance, company accounting policies, and internal control monitoring. Coordinate internal and external audits, including financial statement audits, SOX or internal control reviews, insurance audits, and customer audits. Serve as a liaison between auditors, accounting teams, operations personnel, and executive leadership. Evaluate existing financial and operational processes and recommend improvements that strengthen compliance, reduce risk, and improve reporting integrity. Supervise and mentor Finance Analysts, Project Accountants, and other finance personnel as assigned. Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, professional development, and standardized reporting practices. Drive process efficiency through ERP optimization, reporting tools, dashboards, KPI reporting, automation, and business intelligence solutions. Other duties as assigned. R equired Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Finance , Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field; or equivalent progressive finance experience as determined by company leadership. 10+ years of progressive finance experience. 10+ years of construction industry finance or project accounting experience. Strong knowledge of job costing, Work-in-Progress (WIP) reporting, percentage-of-completion revenue recognition, project profitability analysis, and construction operations finance. Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, cash flow management, financial reporting, audit preparation, compliance, and internal controls. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience with ERP systems in a project-based environment. Strong analytical, organizational, communication, leadership, problem-solving, and executive communication skills. Ability to partner effectively with executive leadership, operations, project management, accounting, auditors, and other cross-functional stakeholders. Experience with COINS+ ERP system. Experience managing finance, project accounting, or operational finance teams. Knowledge of cash management, treasury, corporate financial planning, data analytics, project controls, and business intelligence reporting. title: Director, Engineering - Cloud Detection Platform (Remote)
jd_text: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. About the Role CrowdStrike stops breaches, and detection content is how we do it. The Cloud Detection Platform team builds the engines that execute detection logic in the cloud at massive scale, along with the infrastructure that lets detection engineers author, test, deploy, and manage that content safely across the entire Falcon fleet. We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead this platform. You will manage multiple teams responsible for our cloud detection engines (scheduled, real-time, and retrospective execution across first- and third-party data) and the supporting infrastructure: content management and deployment pipelines, rule lifecycle and exception management, testing and validation environments, and the observability, quotas, and SLOs that keep rule execution reliable and cost-effective for customers. This is a high-leverage role at the center of CrowdStrike's detection strategy. Your platform serves detection engineers across endpoint, cloud, identity, and next-gen SIEM, and every improvement you ship translates directly into faster, higher-quality protection for thousands of customers. title: Staff/Principal Product Manager, Patient Experience
jd_text: Job Title: Staff/Principal Product Manager, Patient Experience Location: Remote, USA ABOUT THE COMPANY Wheel is evolving the traditional care ecosystem by equipping the nation's most innovative companies with a premier platform to deliver high-quality virtual care at scale. We offer proven strategies and cutting-edge technologies to foster consumer engagement, build brand loyalty, and maximize return on investment. Wheel solutions include configurable virtual care programs, an intuitive consumer interface, and access to a nationwide network of board-certified clinicians. Discover how Wheel is transforming the future of healthcare by visiting http://www.wheel.com/www.wheel.com http://www.wheel.com. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Staff/Principal Product Manager, Patient Experience at Wheel, you will own the strategy and roadmap behind the consumer-facing experience that patients use to access care through our enterprise partners. This is a B2B2C role: our patients interact with Wheel through partner brands, so you'll need to design experiences that satisfy a consumer's expectations for a modern healthcare product while also meeting the technical, brand, and compliance requirements of large enterprise partners. You'll operate at a systems level, connecting patient-facing experience decisions to the underlying clinical, operational, and platform architecture that makes those experiences possible. You bring real hands-on experience shaping AI-powered product, not just using AI tools in your own workflow. This is a builder role for a senior product leader who can set a multi-year vision for patient experience and drive it forward through close, hands-on partnership with Engineering. WHAT YOU'LL DO (JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES) Strategy & Vision - Define the multi-year vision and roadmap for the patient experience across Wheel's white-labeled consumer surfaces, balancing partner-specific requirements with a coherent, scalable core product - Establish a point of view on where the patient experience should be standardized across partners versus configured per partner, and build the frameworks to support that decision-making - Translate enterprise partner requirements across market segments into a unified product strategy that serves patients well regardless of the front door they came through - Champion design as a strategic differentiator; work hand-in-hand with Design to set a bar for what a trustworthy, AI+human powered patient experience looks like at scale Systems Thinking & Cross-Functional Execution - Map the patient journey end to end, from first touchpoint through clinical encounter to follow-up, and identify where friction, drop-off, or trust gaps occur - Partner closely with Engineering, Clinical Operations, and partner-facing teams to design solutions that hold up across a distributed network of clinicians and multiple partner integrations - Define the product requirements, success metrics, and evaluation criteria for AI-driven capabilities within the patient experience (for example, intake, triage support, or personalization), including partnering on model and product tradeoffs and on iteration post-launch based on real usage data - Break down ambiguous, cross-functional problems into clear requirements and plans, and drive alignment with Engineering from concept through launch and iteration Cross-Functional Leadership - Act as a primary product voice in conversations with Account Management and their enterprise partners about patient experience, translating patient experience strategy into terms that resonate with partner stakeholders - Communicate vision, tradeoffs, and progress clearly to executive leadership, engineering teams, and non-technical partner stakeholders alike - Mentor and influence other product managers on systems thinking and product craft in partnership with their managers WHO YOU ARE (JOB QUALIFICATIONS) - 8+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning consumer-facing products at a senior or lead level (Staff, Principal or equivalent scope). Leveling will be based on demonstrated scope of impact in the interview process - Direct experience building consumer products, ideally including B2B2C or white-label models where the end user and the paying customer are different - Demonstrated systems thinking: experience designing products that span multiple stakeholders, technical layers, or partner integrations - Real, hands-on experience delivering AI-powered products and features, not just using AI tools in your work. You can speak to the tradeoffs, evaluation methods, and iteration cycles involved in bringing an AI capability to production - Experience navigating the tension between enterprise partner requirements and end-user needs in a B2B2C model, particularly within healthcare or other highly regulated industries, and building product decision frameworks that satisfy compliance, brand, and clinical constraints while still serving the end consumer well - Outstanding written and verbal communicator who can move fluidly between consumer experience detail and executive-level strategy - A track record as a builder: comfortable in ambiguity, willing to get hands-on with design, data, or requirements detail when needed to keep Engineering moving fast Skills & Competencies - Mix of vision and execution: able to set a compelling multi-year direction and also drive the week-to-week product decisions that translate into shipped work - Strong product sense for consumer experience, balanced with the operational and technical judgment needed for a B2B2C model - Experience partnering with enterprise or channel partners on product decisions - Technical fluency across APIs, integration patterns (webhooks, headless architectures, MCP and other emerging protocols), and platform product design - Comfortable synthesizing input from clinical, engineering, data, and partner stakeholders into a clear product direction - Data-driven, with the judgment to know when qualitative signal matters more than a metric - High ownership and autonomy; thrives in a fast-moving, lean environment SALARY AND PERKS Pay Range: $201,700-$301,700 plus equity Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, the final level determined (Staff or Principal), scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations. Wheel is unable to consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position. As an employee of Wheel, you’ll enjoy our Total Rewards Program to help secure your financial future and preserve your health and well-being, including: - Medical, Dental and Vision - Ancillary: Life, Short and Long Term Disability - 401K match - Flexible PTO - Parental Leave - Stock options - Additional programs and perks Wheel is committed to equal employment opportunities for all team members. Every decision we make regarding employment is solely based on merit, competence, and performance. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. title: Principal Product Manager (AI)
jd_text: About Wisdom Wisdom blends industry expertise with advanced technology to make dental practices work better for everyone involved. We believe dentistry is about people, and we exist to make the future of dentistry stronger and more sustainable for dentists, their teams, and the patients they serve. We match administrative teams with expert billers and custom-built technology to take on the heavy lifting of dental billing while maximizing dentists’ time in-office, and their bottom line. Coming from a fresh $21M Series A round of funding we are looking for exceptional candidates to help us build a category-defining company. Wisdom has employees across the US. The Role: Principal Product Manager (AI) Dental insurance billing is one of the largest manual workflows in US healthcare. Claims aging, appeals, posting, follow-ups makes for work that today eats entire FTE teams at every dental practice. The expertise that makes it run lives in the heads of veteran dental billers. We're building AI agents that work alongside them and support them through these workflows. We're hiring a Principal PM to own a major surface of this. Small pods, all builders, reporting to the Head of Product. You'll help shape Wisdom's product strategy for the next 1-3 years. What You'll Do - Own strategy and roadmap for an AI-first product. Balance short-term wins (human-assisted tools) with long-term bets (autonomous AI agents). - Shadow revenue specialists, billers, and dental office managers to understand workflows end-to-end. Translate tribal knowledge from 10+ year industry veterans into structured product workflows and context for AI. - Be on the forefront of AI design patterns. Help us build new agentic workflows, human-in-the-loop UX patterns, AI-to-human escalation paths, and audit trails. - Define gradual autonomy models: when should AI act autonomously vs. escalate to humans. What We're Looking For - 8+ years as a Product Manager, with at least 3 years working on AI/ML products. - You're already shipping AI products. You've built things with LLMs and agent frameworks, you've felt the pain of eval infra and prompt regressions, and you have strong opinions on the mechanics of how we build. - You leverage AI across the entire stack of the job: drafting and pressure-testing strategy, running synthetic user research, building evals before specs, prototyping flows in code, and shipping PRs when it's faster than writing them up. You treat AI like a co-worker you're constantly delegating to and learning from. - You've built pure agentic or human-in-the-loop systems before. You can make tradeoffs between "AI decides, AI performs," "AI suggests, human approves," "AI acts, human audits," or even "AI skipped, human only." Bonus if you've done this in healthcare, fintech, or another regulated space where being wrong has massive consequences. Wisdom is an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law.

jd_text: Based in St. Louis, Core & Main is a leader in advancing reliable infrastructure™ with local service, nationwide®. title: Completion Diagnostics Data Analyst
jd_text: The Completion Diagnostics Data Analyst is responsible for processing all of ProTechnics’ completions diagnostics data into final client deliverables accurately and within the expected turnaround times. Services include chemical tracer data, spectral gamma ray logging of proppant tracers, pressure/temperature logs, and density+spectral gamma logging of sand control completions. Responsibilities will also include explaining and interpreting all of the above products to internal and external clients as needed. DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES Offshore Spectral Gamma/Density Logging: Quickly and accurately process all offshore logging data into final client deliverables (log images, LAS files, PowerPoint slide decks, etc.) within the required 2-4 hour turnaround time. Have sufficient understanding of the log to be able to answer any processing questions from internal or external clients and aid in the interpretation of the log. Onshore Spectral Gamma Logging: Process spectral gamma ray and pressure/temperature log data into all standard client deliverables. Have sufficient understanding of the logs to be able to explain the processing as well as interpret the final results to internal and external clients. Be able to modify standard deliverables as well as create new ones from scratch as required to meet client needs. Chemical Data: QC and load field injection records into internal databases. Process chemical tracer data from the analytical lab into standard reports as well as all extra deliverables (3D wellbore views, inter-well communication matrices, plot representations, etc) at a high level of accuracy and speed. Independently identify and troubleshoot any problems with the data itself or the processing of same. Other Duties: Role may also include processing and analysis of production log data (spinner, temperature, fluid density, etc.). As needed, assist in or take full ownership of one-off and longer-term projects that fall outside the scope of routine daily work. QUALIFICATIONS 2- or 4- year degree, in engineering, geology, or another petroleum-related field preferred. High School or GED required. 2+ years’ experience in well-log field-acquisition or processing strongly preferred (open- or cased-hole). Basic knowledge of well completion techniques and operations is a plus. Experience in production log processing or acquisition is a plus. Intermediate proficiency in Excel, including using and troubleshooting VBA macros helpful. Offshore jobs must be processed as soon as data is received from the field so availability for night/weekend/holiday processing is required. Chemical tracer data and onshore logs occasionally require night/weekend/holiday processing so availability to participate in a rotating on-call schedule for these products is required. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. High degree of accuracy Ability to multitask and manage responsibilities efficiently under time constraints. Good organizational skills. title: Team Lead Operations Account Management
jd_text: The Team Lead, Operations Account Management is responsible for day‑to‑day operational performance and execution for assigned clients, serving as the primary operations liaison between client facilities and internal delivery teams. This role focuses on tactical revenue cycle outcomes, ensuring accurate reporting, effective communication, and consistent execution across billing, follow‑up, collections, denials, and claim resolution workflows. This position is accountable for operational monitoring and client relationship management. The Team Lead translates client needs into clear operational priorities, monitors key performance indicators, identifies risks and trends, and supports timely issue resolution to protect cash, A/R performance, and client satisfaction. The role also provides operational mentorship to staff by reinforcing daily best practices, supporting training and performance efforts, and helping remove execution barriers. Success is measured by client retention, escalation volume, and core revenue cycle performance indicators. These Goals and objectives are not to be construed as a complete statement of all duties performed; employees will be required to perform other job-related duties as required. Goals and objectives are subject to change. All activities must be in compliance with Equal Employment Opportunity laws, HIPAA, ERISA and other regulations, as appropriate. Essential Functions: In addition to meeting performance expectations, this role includes the following specific responsibilities: Discrete Responsibilities (Primary Accountability) Operational Performance Monitoring: Monitor daily operational performance, battle cards, action plans, and key KPIs for assigned clients, including A/R days, cash performance, denial trends, and accuracy measures. Primary Operations Liaison: Act as the primary operational point of contact between clients and internal delivery teams, ensuring timely, accurate, and consistent communication. Operational Translation: Translate client needs, issues, and requests into actionable operational priorities and execution plans. Risk & Trend Identification: Identify operational risks, analyze performance trends, and support issue resolution to prevent revenue leakage and service disruption. Reporting & Communication: Ensure accurate reporting, clear status updates, and effective issue communication to internal stakeholders and, as appropriate, client contacts. Client Scope: Lead operational work for domestic‑only clients as needed. Reporting, Trend Monitoring & Continuous Improvement Trend Monitoring & Corrective Action: Review statistical reports and dashboards to identify operational trends, risks, and deficiencies; develop and implement corrective action plans to improve timeliness, quality, and outcomes. Operational Efficiency: Lead tactical efforts to maximize operational efficiency and optimize reimbursement through standardized workflows, issue triage, and collaboration with cross-functional partners. Client & Stakeholder Relationship Management (Tactical) Liaison & Communication: Act as the primary operational point of contact between facility management and internal teams, ensuring smooth, timely communication and resolution of day-to-day issues. Service Responsiveness & Escalation: Ensure client inquiries are addressed promptly (including providing timelines to resolution), and proactively escalate risks such as unbilled accounts, claim issues, and operational blockers to leadership. Cross-Functional Coordination: Partner with internal teams (e.g., operations, finance, payer relations, technology, and strategic client management/sales counterparts) to drive resolution and maintain a consistent client experience. Contract Awareness & Compliance: Understand contract terms and ensure operational billing, invoicing, and service delivery remain within negotiated requirements. Compliance & Professional Standards Regulatory Knowledge: Maintain current knowledge of hospital billing systems, government payer programs, third-party reimbursement policies, and applicable federal/state regulations. Confidentiality: Maintain confidentiality of patient and client information without exception. Continuous Learning & Industry Awareness: Attend required meetings and remain current on industry trends, legislative changes, and best practices. Customer Invoicing & Accuracy: Ensure accuracy of customer invoices and support monthly invoicing processes as required; validate supporting detail and address discrepancies. Management Expectations / Additional Duties: Perform all functions in alignment with management expectations and complete other duties as assigned. Key Measures of Success Client Retention and Stability Reduction in Client Escalations Cash Performance vs. Goal A/R Days and Denial Trends Staff Management Responsible for ensuring area of responsibility has the talent and resources to meet short- and long-term organizational goals as well as ensuring maximum productivity and performance. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Proactively recruit, screen, and select candidates for current and future resource requirements. Effectively orient new hires to ensure a positive and productive employee engagement experience. Ensure structure and hiring plans (within budget) are appropriate for performance and productivity levels required. Utilize the company’s performance management program as designed to align individual performance to overall performance objectives. Meet all completion requirements at a high quality level. Provide ongoing performance feedback. Identify and take appropriate action for non-performance. Ensure each employee has a yearly performance review that is reviewed with employee and the review to be sent to Human Resources each year. Ensure each employee has a clear and thorough understanding of their role and responsibilities. Keep job descriptions current for each position. Actively support and participate in organizational development and training programs. Meet all completion requirements at a high quality level. Mentor, guide, and coach direct reports in order to expand their capabilities and performance. Communicate all corporate matters in a positive and timely manner as directed by Corporate Communications or senior managements. Administer all internal policies and procedures in accordance with corporate, human resources, budgetary, and finance guidelines. Ensure accuracy of staff data records. Comply with all employment laws and regulations including, but not limited to, equal employment opportunities for all. Minimum Requirements: Education/Experience/Certification Requirements Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience (to support internal flexibility for hiring and promotion). 5+ years of experience in hospital revenue cycle functions with strong exposure to billing and follow-up/collections and claim resolution. Working knowledge of insurance regulations, reimbursement practices, procedure and diagnosis coding, and automated billing workflows. Demonstrated ability to work issues to resolution, including complex account research, root cause identification, and corrective actions. Strong client-facing communication skills (written and verbal) with the ability to explain operational findings, timelines, and next steps clearly. Excellent critical thinking, organizational, and time-management skills with strong attention to detail, accuracy, and follow-through. Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word) and comfort working across multiple systems and reporting outputs. Preferred Qualifications: 2+ years Medicare hospital billing experience and/or demonstrated expertise with government payers (Medicare/Medicaid). Experience supporting hospital billing platforms and/or EHR/RCM systems (e.g., Thrive, Epic, Cerner, or comparable tools). Advanced revenue cycle analytics capability (e.g., trending denials/underpayments, operational KPI reporting, dashboard interpretation). Prior experience in a role requiring client management, escalations, service recovery, and cross-functional coordination. Exposure to invoicing processes, contract compliance validation, and operational performance governance. Manager

title: IT Infrastructure Manager
jd_text: CrossCountry Mortgage (CCM) is the nation's number one distributed retail mortgage lender with more than 9,000 employees operating over 700 branches and servicing loans across all 50 states, D.C. and Puerto Rico. Our company has been recognized ten times on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private businesses and has received many awards for our standout culture. A culture where you can grow! CCM has created an exceptional culture driving employee engagement, exceeding employee expectations, and directly impacting company success. At our core, our entrepreneurial spirit empowers every employee to be who they are to help us move forward together. You’ll get unwavering support from all departments and total transparency from the top down. CCM offers eligible employees a competitive compensation plan and a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, as well as a 401K. We also offer company-provided short-term disability, an employee assistance program, and a wellness program. Position Overview: The IT Infrastructure Manager leads a team responsible for the engineering, delivery, modernization, and continuous improvement of CCM’s enterprise infrastructure platforms. This role is accountable for designing, building, and delivering secure, scalable, resilient, and supportable technology solutions across CCM’s hybrid infrastructure environment. This is a BUILD-focused leadership role responsible for infrastructure strategy, engineering standards, project delivery, automation, platform modernization, and operational readiness. The IT Infrastructure Manager partners closely with Enterprise Architecture, Security & Risk, Technology Operations, PMO, and business technology stakeholders to ensure infrastructure solutions are well-designed, well-documented, secure, repeatable, and ready for operational support. This role encompasses cloud infrastructure, on-premises infrastructure, network engineering, identity and access platforms, Microsoft 365 and collaboration foundations, endpoint platform foundations, automation, Infrastructure as Code, and enterprise platform delivery. Job Responsibilities: Develop and execute short- and long-term infrastructure roadmaps that support CCM’s business growth, technology modernization, and operational resilience. Translate enterprise technology objectives into practical infrastructure plans across hybrid cloud, AWS, Azure, networking, identity, endpoint foundations, collaboration platforms, and core enterprise services. Define and maintain infrastructure engineering standards, reference architectures, design patterns, documentation expectations, and operational readiness requirements. Drive scalable, repeatable infrastructure delivery through automation, Infrastructure as Code, standard templates, reusable patterns, and disciplined change management. Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Security & Risk to ensure infrastructure solutions align with enterprise architecture principles, security controls, compliance expectations, and business continuity requirements. Evaluate emerging technologies, vendors, services, tools, and delivery models that improve reliability, scalability, cost efficiency, security, and engineering velocity. Develop business cases, cost-benefit analyses, and recommendations for infrastructure investments, modernization initiatives, and platform improvements. Lead the design, engineering, and implementation of infrastructure solutions across CCM’s hybrid environment, including AWS, Azure, on-premises platforms, networking, identity/IAM, Microsoft 365, collaboration tools, and endpoint platform foundations. Oversee infrastructure project delivery from intake through design, implementation, testing, documentation, transition, and operational handoff. Ensure new infrastructure solutions are secure by design, observable, resilient, cost-conscious, supportable, and aligned with enterprise standards. Drive adoption of modern deployment practices, including Infrastructure as Code, Git-based workflows, CI/CD pipelines, automated configuration, scripting, and repeatable release patterns. Provide leadership for infrastructure modernization efforts, lifecycle management, cloud adoption, platform consolidation, technical debt reduction, and service improvement initiatives. Ensure infrastructure designs include appropriate monitoring, alerting, logging, backup, recovery, capacity, performance, and support requirements before transition to Operations. Partner with Technology Operations to ensure clean handoffs, clear runbooks, escalation paths, knowledge transfer, and operational support models. Manage engineering delivery across core infrastructure domains, including cloud platforms, network services, identity services, directory services, collaboration platforms, and enterprise productivity foundations. Support AWS as a required platform capability and Azure as a preferred platform capability, ensuring cloud environments are built with strong governance, security, resiliency, automation, and cost-management practices. Provide leadership across network engineering capabilities such as LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP, firewall coordination, connectivity, segmentation, cloud networking, and performance optimization. Guide identity and access platform initiatives involving Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, MFA, privileged access, conditional access, lifecycle management, and least-privilege access models. Support Microsoft 365 and collaboration platform foundations, including governance, platform configuration, security alignment, service enablement, and enterprise adoption needs. Partner with endpoint, security, and operations teams to ensure endpoint platform foundations are standardized, manageable, secure, and aligned with enterprise requirements. Partner with Security & Risk to embed security requirements into infrastructure designs, implementation plans, and operational readiness criteria. Ensure infrastructure platforms support appropriate controls for identity, access, logging, encryption, vulnerability management, patching, lifecycle management, backup, recovery, and resiliency. Support disaster recovery, business continuity, incident readiness, and infrastructure resilience planning. Participate in major incident reviews, root cause analysis, remediation planning, and continuous improvement activities as an infrastructure engineering leader. Ensure infrastructure documentation, architecture diagrams, standards, implementation records, and support procedures remain current and audit-ready. Establish strong delivery practices that balance speed, quality, security, supportability, and long-term maintainability. Maintain clear communication with IT leadership, project stakeholders, Technology Operations, Security & Risk, Enterprise Architecture, PMO, business partners, and vendors. Provide executive-ready updates on infrastructure initiatives, risks, delivery progress, resource needs, dependencies, and decision points. Define and track key performance indicators related to infrastructure delivery, platform health, project execution, technical debt reduction, automation, and operational readiness. Serve as an escalation point for complex infrastructure engineering issues, major production concerns, and high-priority platform decisions. Ensure infrastructure work is prioritized, planned, delivered, documented, and transitioned effectively. Lead, coach, and develop a team of infrastructure engineers and technical professionals. Set clear goals, priorities, standards, and expectations for team delivery, quality, documentation, collaboration, and accountability. Manage team capacity, resource planning, work assignments, performance feedback, hiring, onboarding, and professional development. Build a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, engineering discipline, service excellence, and cross-functional partnership. Promote knowledge sharing, standardization, mentoring, and repeatable delivery practices across the infrastructure team. Manage vendor relationships, technology evaluations, renewals, support agreements, and infrastructure-related procurement activities. Support infrastructure budget planning, forecasting, cloud cost management, licensing reviews, and cost optimization efforts. Partner with PMO and IT leadership to manage the infrastructure project portfolio, prioritize demand, identify delivery risks, and ensure alignment to enterprise objectives. Evaluate infrastructure investments based on business value, risk reduction, operational impact, scalability, security, and total cost of ownership. Participate in escalation support for major incidents, high-priority infrastructure issues, and critical production events. title: Clinical Informatics Specialist
jd_text: About Crossover Health Crossover Health is creating the future of health as it should be. A national, team-based medical group with a focus on wellbeing and prevention that extends beyond traditional sick care, the company delivers an entirely new model of healthcare—Primary Health—built on the foundation of trusted relationships, an interdisciplinary care team approach, and outcomes-based payment. Crossover’s Primary Health model integrates primary care, physical medicine, mental health, health coaching, care navigation and more, and delivers care in surround-sound—in-person, virtually and via asynchronous messaging. Together we are building a community of members that embraces healthcare as a proactive part of their lifestyle. Job Summary Job Responsibilities The Clinical Application & Informatics Specialist plays a key role in supporting and optimizing clinical systems, particularly EHR and related applications. This mid-level role combines informatics strategy with hands-on application support and cross-functional collaboration. You’ll serve as both a systems expert and a clinical operations partner—helping bridge technology with real-world care delivery. Informatics & Strategic Enablement: Lead clinical informatics initiatives that support the integration and optimization of EHR and other clinical systems. Collaborate with product, IT, and data teams to ensure clinical requirements are reflected in platform design and functionality. Gather and prioritize provider and clinical staff feedback to support system improvements and user experience enhancements. Contribute to interoperability efforts, including the evaluation of data exchange standards, APIs, and vendor integrations. Assist in managing vendor relationships and ensuring service-level expectations are met. Training & Adoption: Develop training materials, job aids, and tip sheets to support user onboarding and change management. Deliver training and go-live support to providers, nurses, and operational staff. Document clinical workflows and maintain system configuration records. Project Coordination: Support project timelines, testing plans, and implementation checklists for system changes or new tool rollouts. Track KPIs and performance metrics related to system usage and provider satisfaction. Participate in informatics and operations meetings to align on organizational goals and identify opportunities for improvement. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare, Health Informatics, Nursing, Information Systems, or related field. 3–5+ years of experience in clinical informatics, clinical application support, or health IT. Hands-on experience configuring and supporting EHR systems; experience with Athenahealth is a strong plus. Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards (e.g., HL7, FHIR, APIs). Excellent communication and change management skills, with experience translating clinical needs into technical solutions. Strong problem-solving abilities and a collaborative mindset. Preferred Qualifications Master's preferred. Preferred certifications: CPHIMS, PMP, Athena or Epic certifications, or relevant technical training. title: Global Procurement Category Lead Engineering and Construction

Drive Innovation Lead and participate in global transformation projects and continuous improvement initiatives as required to ensure the delivery of targeted benefits. Minimum 2 years senior leadership experience, preferably of a global team. Minimum 5 years in global team management. Strong communication and influencing skills and ability to deal with ambiguity and building bridges Strong understanding of the A&E/EPC/EPCM, CQV/CSV categories and business Understanding of the pharmaceutical industry or related industry preferred but not essential Competencies Maintains an external and strategic focus for self and team Ensures teams are set up for collaboration Creates an accountable working environment Instills personal flexibility in self and team Ensures clarity around the strategy Coaches effectively Additionally, this role requires other knowledge, skills and competencies including: Basic strategic orientation, inquisitive, comfortable with ambiguity, and self-motivated to identify trends and improvement opportunities aligned with business objectives and strategic plans. Strong executive presence demonstrated leadership and collaboration skills with ability to build effective relationships and influence peers and key stakeholders. Demonstrated strength and ability to organize and lead global teams. Strong project management skills with ability to plan tasks, assign resources, manage progress, remove barriers, manage change, resolve conflict, build consensus, and motivate team members across multiple projects concurrently. Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to tailor messages to the given audience, present information in a clear and concise manner, apply creative approaches to engage audiences, manage change, resolve conflict, and build consensus. Solid Category Management, Strategic Sourcing, and Supplier Relationship Management knowledge The position also requires the ability to build and maintain strong relationships and collaborate effectively with all levels and cross functionally within the organization. title: Fixed Income Operations Analyst
jd_text: Voleon is a technology company that applies state-of-the-art AI and machine learning techniques to real-world problems in finance. For nearly two decades, we have led our industry and worked at the frontier of applying AI/ML to investment management. We have become a multibillion-dollar asset manager, and we have ambitious goals for the future. Your colleagues will include internationally recognized experts in machine learning research as well as highly experienced finance and technology professionals. You will be working with strategies that are at the forefront of machine learning and statistical trading. The strategies have been carefully designed to generate non-correlated returns. Our firm and its strategies are the product of many years of meticulous research and craftsmanship, and you will lead the way in bringing them to investors. In addition to our enriching and collegial working environment, we offer highly competitive compensation and benefits packages, technology talks by our experts, a beautiful modern office, daily catered lunches, and more. As a Fixed Income Operations Analyst, you will play a key role in supporting Voleon’s fixed income operations. You will be responsible for overseeing workflows related to trade settlements, corporate actions, and reconciliations. In addition to managing day-to-day operational processes, you will contribute to cross-functional initiatives aimed at enhancing and scaling Voleon’s operational infrastructure. This role sits within the Fund Operations team, working closely with colleagues across trading, research, and accounting. You will report directly to the Fund Operations Manager and collaborate regularly with senior leadership, including the CFO. This position offers a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact as a core member of Voleon’s credit operations function. RESPONSIBILITIES - Oversee fixed income trade settlement operations, including trade exception management, inquiries, allocations, fail resolution, and position transfers - Manage the end-to-end corporate actions process by conducting research, evaluating event details, and coordinating with traders on elections and potential liabilities - Maintain and summarize an internal workboard leveraged by trading, research, and engineering teams, ensuring effective communication and cross-functional alignment - Reconcile internal books and records with the prime brokers and fund administrator, promptly investigating and resolving breaks - Collaborate with the Fund Accounting team to ensure all transactions are accurately recorded, including participation in cash reconciliations and month-end reviews - Enhance operational efficiency through process improvements and automation initiatives - Support firm-wide projects such as broker onboardings, restructurings, and new account setups - Participate in cross-training programs, workflow reviews, and coverage planning to promote team scalability and resilience - Liaise with external service providers to identify process improvements and maintain compliance with evolving policies and control standards - Contribute to the development and refinement of internal policies, procedures, and best practices REQUIREMENTS - 5-10 years of finance experience, ideally in an operations role or other middle office role at a hedge fund, broker-dealer, or fund administrator - Ability to work between the hours of 7am to 5pm PST - Advanced abilities in Microsoft Excel - Experience working with or the ability to learn enterprise-level accounting software and develop efficient processes - Experience automating manual processes (preferred) with a focus on leveraging AI LLMs and AI coding tools - title: Senior Operations Manager
jd_text: Join Vetcove and help modernize the future of veterinary software and the pet parent healthcare experience. Our suite of platforms features a market-leading procurement marketplace, an ultra-modern home delivery ecommerce experience, and a next-generation practice management system. More than 25,000 hospitals across all 50 states rely on Vetcove daily, supporting tens of thousands of veterinarians who care for tens of millions of pets each year. We are modernizing the 50 billion dollar plus animal health industry by giving veterinary organizations the tools to focus more on patient care. Backed by Y Combinator and top venture investors in Silicon Valley, New York and Miami, Vetcove is a fast-growing, mission-driven company. We are searching for talented and passionate people who want to help shape the future of veterinary care. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own Vendor Performance Management: Run the weekly performance cadence across all fulfillment vendors: scorecard reviews, follow-ups, and corrective action plans; and hold partners accountable to SLAs with persistence and professionalism. - Manage Partner Relationships: Serve as the primary relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of fulfillment vendors: own the recurring meeting cadence, lead business reviews, advocate for Vetcove externally, and keep relationships strong through the ups and downs of operational performance. - Analyze at Scale: Interrogate large datasets (SQL, Excel, BI tools) to identify root causes, quantify operational impact, and build the case for process and integration changes. Defend your conclusions with data. - Partner with Product & Engineering: Translate recurring operational failure modes into integration and fulfillment improvements; write clear requirements, drive prioritization, and follow through until fixes ship and the metrics move. - Operationalize New Initiatives: Take run-state ownership of newly launched programs: build the SOPs, own the KPIs, and make the operational decisions that keep them healthy at scale. - Build Operational Rigor: Author and maintain SOPs, escalation paths, and process documentation that make our vendor operations consistent, auditable, and scalable as the platform grows. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - 5-8 years of experience in operations, program management, marketplace/ecommerce operations, or supply chain – ideally in roles where you were accountable for external partner performance. - A documented record of relentless follow-through: you chase answers across organizations, escalate when needed, never let a thread die, and deliver on time without being reminded. - Strong analytical skills: proficiency in SQL (or demonstrated equivalent), advanced Excel/Sheets, and comfort drawing defensible conclusions from large, messy datasets. - Exceptional attention to detail: you notice the mismatched count, the silent data gap, the SLA miss buried in an average. - Experience managing vendor or partner relationships end to end; serving as a partner’s main point of contact, and balancing relationship-building with direct, constructive accountability conversations. - Excellent written communication and the ability to work cross-functionally with product and engineering teams. - Self-directed and highly organized in a fully remote environment. NICE TO HAVE - Experience in ecommerce fulfillment, 3PL, pharmacy, or distribution operations. - Familiarity with BI/analytics tools (e.g., Hex, Looker, Tableau) and building or maintaining operational dashboards. - Background in animal health, healthcare, or another regulated fulfillment category. BENEFITS (FULL TIME ROLES) - 100% remote within the USA - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Automatic 401k contribution - Employee referral program - At home office set up - Bi-annual company retreats - Open vacation policy - Equity - Monthly team events The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is: $100,000/year -$150,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits. The range reflects the base hourly rate or annual compensation (as applicable), and does not include bonus, equity or other incentives. In addition to base compensation, Vetcove offers a comprehensive benefits package. Please refer to the “Benefits (Full Time Roles)” section above for more details. title: Commercial Strategy and Operations Manager
jd_text: Virta Health is on a mission to reverse metabolic disease in one billion people. Current treatment approaches aren’t working—over half of US adults have either type 2 diabetes or prediabetes, and obesity rates are at an all-time high. Virta is changing this by helping people reverse their metabolic condition through innovations in technology, personalized nutrition, and virtual care delivery reinvented from the ground up. We have raised over $350 million from top-tier investors, and partner with the largest health plans, employers, and government organizations to help their employees and members restore their health and take back their lives. Join us on our mission to reverse metabolic disease in one billion people. The Commercial Strategy and Operations Manager will lead key components of the Commercial Strategy and Operations function, serving as a strategic partner to Commercial leaders. This role will independently translate business priorities into actionable plans, strengthen operating processes, and deliver data-driven insights that improve decision-making and advance Commercial goals. This is an individual contributor role with significant functional ownership and cross-functional influence. RESPONSIBILITIES - Own core Commercial Strategy and Operations processes, including operational reporting, OKR performance management, forecasting, and planning. - Translate Commercial goals into well-defined projects, priorities, and operating plans, creating focus and accountability across stakeholders. - Independently lead complex cross-functional initiatives from scoping through implementation, proactively managing risks, dependencies, decisions, and communication. - Serve as a strategic partner to Commercial leaders by translating complex or ambiguous data into clear insights, business implications, and actionable recommendations. - Develop executive- and Board-level materials that communicate performance, emerging risks and opportunities, and recommended actions. - Identify and implement scalable improvements to Commercial processes, systems, and reporting, using data to demonstrate impact and establish best practices. 90 DAY PLAN Within your first 90 days at Virta, we expect you will do the following: - Develop a strong understanding of Virta’s Commercial strategy, teams, performance drivers, and cross-functional dependencies. - Establish trusted relationships with Commercial leaders and key partners across the organization. - Assume ownership of core Commercial reporting, planning, and OKR operating cadences. - Identify and begin leading a high-impact initiative that improves Commercial effectiveness or operational efficiency. MUST-HAVES - 5-7 years at a leading management consulting firm, investment bank, or internal strategy team - Proven ability to independently lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from strategy through implementation. - Strong analytical capabilities, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and translate data into actionable recommendations. - Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to influence leaders and cross-functional partners. - Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets, business intelligence tools, and Salesforce VALUES-DRIVEN CULTURE Virta’s company values drive our culture, so you’ll do well if: - You put people first and take care of yourself, your peers, and our patients equally - You have a strong sense of ownership and take initiative while empowering others to do the same - You prioritize positive impact over busy work - You have no ego and understand that everyone has something to bring to the table regardless of experience - You appreciate transparency and promote trust and empowerment through open access of information - You are evidence-based and prioritize data and science over seniority or dogma - You take risks and rapidly iterate Is this role not quite what you're looking for? title: Marketplace Operations Manager II
jd_text: Job Title: Marketplace Operations Manager II Job Location (Remote): Remote, USA About the Company Wheel is evolving the traditional care ecosystem by equipping the nation's most innovative companies with a premier platform to deliver high-quality virtual care at scale. We offer proven strategies and cutting-edge technologies to foster consumer engagement, build brand loyalty, and maximize return on investment. Wheel solutions include configurable virtual care programs, an intuitive consumer interface, and access to a nationwide network of board-certified clinicians. Discover how Wheel is transforming the future of healthcare by visiting www.wheel.com http://www.wheel.com. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Marketplace Operations Manager II to own visit delivery for a defined set of Wheel's client programs. This is an operator's role for someone who wants day-to-day ownership of critical business outcomes - and can carry that accountability even when some levers live with peer functions. You'll take on the complex, ambiguous problems that come with scaling a fast-growing telehealth marketplace - from stabilizing a roster through demand volatility, to leading cross-functional projects that shape how Marketplace Operations scales next. You will own the visit delivery SLA commitments, program-level consult cost performance, and the roster health for your clients. Separate functions on the team own overall clinician supply forecasting, clinician performance management, and scheduling - freeing you up to optimize their use within your programs. This is a role for someone who wants to run marketplace operations for key clients end-to-end: launching and configuring new client programs, writing the operational playbooks your programs run on, and deploying incentive spend within guardrails - while trusting peer functions to own adjacent responsibilities in order for you to maintain a singular, maniacal focus on client performance. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Program Performance and Delivery - Own marketplace performance outcomes (contractual and otherwise) for your assigned client programs: SLA attainment, program-level clinician pay cost, and roster/staffing health. - Own roster composition and staffing strategy for your programs, building and adjusting rosters to ensure SLA through client growth, churn, and short-term volatility. - Own operational data analytics and reporting for your programs - pulling and interrogating utilization, breach-pattern, and profitability data yourself and turning it into recommendations and actions - Own the operating rhythm and upward performance visibility for your programs: recurring performance reviews of SLA, utilization, and cost that turns into actions. - Partner with the Capacity Planner to understand near-term volatility and how it may affect client demand (ie demand surges, modality changes, etc) and own the operational response for your programs (escalation thresholds, incentive levers, roster mix) to keep the program on track. Cost and Incentives - Optimize program-level clinician pay cost and deploy consult incentive spend within a defined budget. - Own the cost plan for your programs and be accountable to variance - partner with the Director of Marketplace on expected cost-per-consult, and keep your lever costs calibrated so you know how to deploy your incentives appropriately. Real-Time Response and Agent Oversight - Author the real-time escalation and response playbook your programs run on: thresholds, approved corrective actions, escalation triggers. Real-time monitoring and AI agents execute against the playbook you write, and you refine how they act on your programs as their capabilities grow. - Review how the agents act on your programs - audit their decisions for quality, catch policy drift or mistakes early, and feed corrections back into the playbook and the agent logic. You're the human-in-the-loop that keeps automated responses trustworthy on your book. - Partner with clinician management peers to relay clinician performance observations that impact your programs and to identify roster improvements that will drive your client performance. Client Launches and Partnership - Partner with Customer Success as the operational counterpart on the client's commercial relationship - supporting quarterly business reviews and the real-world story behind client performance. - Own launch supply-readiness with Provider Operations and the Capacity Planner - ensuring clinicians are credentialed, licensed, and activated in the right states, at the volume the program needs, before go-live. - Lead new-client implementation - configuration and setup - as part of cross functional onboarding teams, and own expansions for programs you already run. - Support strategic projects across Marketplace Operations as they arise. WHO YOU ARE - An operator with experience working in fast-paced, high-demand environments - someone who digs into the details to find root cause, spots broken or inefficient processes, and builds the fix rather than just flagging the problem. - Experience owning end-to-end operational performance in a marketplace, logistics, or two-sided platform environment (delivery, rideshare, staffing, workforce management) - direct accountability for SLA, throughput, or cost. - Strategic thinker who connects day-to-day program performance to the bigger picture - you can zoom out from a single roster or escalation to spot the pattern worth fixing structurally, and zoom back in to execute it. - A strong cross-functional partner and team player - you know how to work through peer teams and different personalities to drive your program's outcomes, even when you don't own every lever yourself. - Strong data fluency. You pull and interrogate your own SLA, completion, utilization, and cost-to-plan data and drive decisions from it - hands-on with SQL, Looker, and Excel - rather than waiting for someone to translate it for you. - A direct, clear communicator who authors and revises the procedures your programs run on - escalation playbooks, response plans, launch runbooks - rather than only following ones someone else wrote. NICE TO HAVE Don't let these stand in your way—they’re just added bonuses! If you meet most of the core requirements, we encourage you to apply. - Exposure to multi-state licensure, credentialing, or other regulated-workforce dynamics. - Experience launching or configuring new client programs in a marketplace or platform business. - Healthcare, telehealth, or regulated-workforce experience. - Marketplace or platform experience. SALARY AND PERKS Pay Range: $122,075- $155,000 plus equity Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations. Wheel is unable to consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position. As an employee of Wheel, you’ll enjoy our Total Rewards Program to help secure your financial future and preserve your health and well-being, including: - Medical, Dental and Vision - Ancillary: Life, Short and Long Term Disability - 401K match - Flexible PTO - Parental Leave - Stock options - Additional programs and perks Wheel is committed to equal employment opportunities for all team members. Every decision we make regarding employment is solely based on merit, competence, and performance. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. At Wheel, we encourage women, people of color, and LGBTQ+ job seekers to apply for positions even if they don’t check every box for the role.

title: Operations Team Lead

Monitor KPIs, conduct audits, and perform spot checks to drive ongoing improvements - Oversee the accuracy of reporting and dashboard data, and help build and refine new dashboards and views (including with AI-assisted tools) - Facilitate monthly check-ins with each office and lead Quarterly Business Reviews to dive into ROI, key metrics, and growth opportunities - Communicate directly with client office staff about AR successes, opportunities, and operational challenges - Respond to customer communications promptly, setting a high standard for responsiveness and resolution - Work closely with other team leads, managers, and stakeholders to align operational goals with overall company objectives - Embrace innovation by designing and implementing new systems and tailored solutions that streamline workflows and address emerging challenges WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - Deep knowledge of the dental billing space, revenue cycle, and AR; experience in medical billing or healthcare billing or healthcare services is a strong plus - Experience leading several client profile types, including DSO, multi-group, specialty, general, and startup practices - A people leader who can hire, develop, motivate, and manage performance, not only resolve conflict - Manages in a reliable, professional manner and shows up for clients with a polished, professional presence every day - Business operations minded, with a strong sense of how the day-to-day connects to broader business goals, margins, and growth - Operationally sophisticated: able to independently own KPIs, spot improvement opportunities, and build or improve dashboards and reporting - A strong, decisive communicator with natural leadership skills and a customer-first mindset - Confident in navigating tough conversations and performance management - Adaptable, coachable, and comfortable with fast-paced change - Highly detail-oriented with excellent client communication skills - Proficient with tech platforms such as Hubspot, Google Suite, and several dental billing softwares - Reliable and available during core U.S. business hours - A strategic thinker and detail-oriented executor PERKS & BENEFITS - Full-time W2 position - Competitive base salary + quarterly bonus - Flexible Paid Time Off - Fully remote, U.S.-based - 401(k) - Health, dental, vision, life, and HSA benefits - Paid parental leave - Company-provided computer If you’re a strategic thinker, decisive communicator, and tech-savvy leader who knows how to bring out the best in people, we’d love to connect. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law.

title: Director, AI Governance & Enterprise Solutions
jd_text: Job Description Position Overview Reporting to the SVP, Software Engineering and AI Operations, the Director of AI Governance & Enterprise Solutions is Momentive's senior AI subject matter expert — the person who sets the technical bar for how the company designs, builds, deploys, and governs AI agents. This role owns the Momentive Context Library, defines and enforces the standards that all AI agents must meet, leads the review and approval of agents across the portfolio, and directly builds agents and skills for the AI Operations Hub. When business units need to build AI solutions, this leader will be a strategic technical partner. Core Responsibilities Context Library Ownership Own the Momentive Context Library — the shared knowledge repository that AI agents across the company depend on for accurate, consistent, organization-specific context. Define the library's architecture, taxonomy, and content standards, ensuring it is well-organized, current, and designed to be consumed reliably by agents across different use cases. Define and maintain the standards for centrally-owned content — shared company knowledge, cross-functional reference material, and foundational context that spans business units — ensuring it remains accurate, current, and consistently structured. Partner with AI Operations Hub spoke leads to help them build, structure, and maintain department-owned content — including converting existing documentation and institutional knowledge into library-ready context. Agent Review & Standards Define the technical review criteria and quality standards that all AI agents, skills, and connectors must meet for AI Operations Hub approval — covering design, architecture, data handling, accuracy, safety, and operational readiness. Lead the technical review and approval process for all AI agents submitted through the AI Operations Hub intake process, making or formally endorsing go/no-go recommendations. Develop agent development guidelines, design patterns, and templates that translate AI Operations Hub standards into practical, reusable building blocks for spoke teams. Identify systemic quality issues, common failure modes, and emerging risks across the agent portfolio, and use those insights to continuously raise the technical bar. Building for AI Operations Directly design and build AI agents, skills, and connectors for the AI Operations team's own use — including tooling that supports AI Operations Hub functions like intake review, registry management, and performance monitoring. Prototype and evaluate new agent architectures, orchestration frameworks, and tooling approaches before recommending them for broader organizational use. Technical Consulting & Deployment Guidance Serve as the primary technical advisor to spoke teams as they design and build AI solutions — providing hands-on architecture guidance, reviewing approach before build begins, and troubleshooting when things go wrong. Own the AI Operations Hub's standards for how agents are deployed, monitored, and secured in production — including environment configuration, observability requirements, access controls, and incident response protocols. Partner with Corporate IT on the platform and infrastructure decisions that affect how agents are deployed and maintained across the organization. Assess and recommend AI platforms, tools, and vendor solutions as the technology landscape evolves, with a focus on what will actually serve Momentive's operational model. Partner on how AI agents and automation intersect with the enterprise application portfolio — aligning platform strategy, tooling investments, and governance standards across both functions. Enablement Develop technical reference materials, design pattern libraries, and decision guides that help spoke teams make better architectural choices independently. Deliver targeted technical training and workshops when spoke teams need to build a foundational capability — this is a supporting function, not a primary one. Actively connect spoke teams to each other — surfacing shared use cases, reusable patterns, and prior work across business units so teams build on each other's progress instead of solving the same problems independently. Other duties as assigned. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 7+ years of hands-on experience designing and building software or AI systems, with at least 3 years working directly with large language models, AI agents, and production AI deployments. Deep practical expertise with AI agent architectures, LLM APIs, orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar), and the tradeoffs between them. Expert-level knowledge of prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use and function calling, context window management, and agent evaluation methodologies. Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI agents in production environments — including decisions around deployment architecture, observability, access controls, and failure handling. Experience designing or governing shared knowledge repositories, context management systems, or information architectures for AI systems. Strong instincts for AI risk — understanding where agents fail, how to test for it, and how to build systems that degrade gracefully. Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Claude Enterprise, Azure OpenAI Service, Google Vertex AI, or similar. Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to make complex technical positions clear and defensible to both engineering and non-technical leadership audiences. Familiarity with AI governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF or similar) and responsible AI principles as they apply to production systems. Experience operating in a cross-functional environment where you set standards others must follow, not just your own team. Demonstrated growth mindset and commitment to staying ahead in a rapidly evolving field. What Success Looks Like Every AI agent that reaches production has been reviewed against a clear, defensible technical standard — and the review process makes agents better, not just slower. The Momentive Context Library is the most trusted source of organizational knowledge available to AI agents — current, well-structured, and actively relied upon by spoke teams. AI Operations' own agents are high-quality, well-maintained, and set the standard that spoke teams aspire to. Spoke teams leave technical consultations with a clearer path forward and better architectural decisions than they would have made on their own. Production agents are deployed consistently, monitored reliably, and secured according to a clear, documented standard. The AI Operation’s Hub technical bar is high and rising — and the organization's AI portfolio reflects it. New capabilities are evaluated and piloted by the AI Operations Hub before spoke teams start asking for them. About Us Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Mission-driven nonprofits and associations rely on Momentive’s cloud-based software and services to address their most pressing challenges – from engaging their communities to simplifying operations and growing revenue. Designed to help organizations connect more, manage more, and ultimately expect more, Momentive's solutions are built with reliability at the core and strategically focus on fundraising, learning, events, careers, volunteering, accounting, and association management. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com . Why Work Here? At Momentive Software, we’re a team of passionate problem-solvers, innovators, and volunteers who believe in using technology to make a real difference. We dream big, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that help our customers drive meaningful change. If you’re looking for a place where your work matters and your ideas are valued, you’ll find it here. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, which is why we do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.
