title: Regional Director
jd_text: Job Description The Regional Director, Store Operations is responsible for leading a high-performing team of District Managers to drive operational excellence, profitable sales growth, talent development, and exceptional customer experiences across an assigned region. This role provides leadership and accountability for the financial, operational, merchandising, and people performance of all stores within the region. Reporting directly to the Zone Vice President, the Regional Director serves as the senior operational leader for the region, translating zone strategy into execution through a team of District Managers. This role partners closely with Human Resources, Asset Protection, Real Estate, Store Support Center teams, and other cross-functional partners to drive operational consistency, profitable growth, and talent development while ensuring Dollar Tree standards are consistently executed across the region. Principal Duties & Responsibilities Operational Leadership & Execution Lead, develop, and hold accountable a team of District Managers responsible for achieving sales, profitability, operational, and customer service objectives. Execute zone priorities and strategic initiatives while ensuring consistent execution across all stores within the region. Drive consistent execution of company programs, operational initiatives, merchandising standards, and store processes. Conduct regular business reviews to evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and implement action plans to improve results. Ensure stores maintain high standards of presentation, merchandising, inventory management, signage, and operational excellence. Promote a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement throughout the region. Provide regular updates and business insights to the Zone Vice President regarding sales performance, operational opportunities, talent needs, and market conditions. Financial Management & Business Performance Maintain full P&L accountability for the assigned region, including sales, payroll, expenses, shrink, and profitability. Analyze key business metrics and company reporting to identify trends, opportunities, and performance gaps. Develop and execute strategies to drive profitable sales growth while effectively managing expenses and operating costs. Ensure District Managers effectively utilize reporting and analytics to identify business outliers and improve store performance. Build financial acumen within the field leadership team through coaching, business reviews, and performance management. Talent Development & Organizational Leadership Recruit, develop, and retain top talent at all levels within the region. Create succession plans and leadership development strategies to build a strong pipeline of future District Managers and Store Managers. Coach and mentor District Managers to strengthen leadership capabilities, operational expertise, and business acumen. Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, talent acquisition, employee relations, performance management, and organizational development initiatives. Facilitate leadership meetings, town halls, onboarding programs, and development sessions as needed to support business objectives. Merchandising & Customer Experience Partner with the Zone Vice President and Zone Operations Director to ensure effective execution of merchandising initiatives and sales-driving programs. Drive operational and merchandising consistency across all stores while maintaining Dollar Tree’s value, convenience, and discovery shopping experience. Ensure stores deliver a high level of customer service through strong leadership presence, associate engagement, and operational execution. Identify and communicate field opportunities that support sales growth, operational efficiencies, and customer satisfaction. Asset Protection, Compliance & Inventory Integrity Foster a strong shrink-awareness culture and ensure effective execution of asset protection programs across the region. Partner with Asset Protection and Risk Management teams to reduce loss, improve compliance, and protect company assets. Maintain accountability for inventory integrity, inventory controls, and operational compliance standards. Ensure stores operate in compliance with company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements. Strategic Growth & Cross-Functional Partnership Support the Zone Vice President in executing strategic growth plans, market expansion initiatives, organizational development efforts, and operational priorities across the region. Partner with Real Estate teams to identify opportunities for new stores, relocations, expansions, and market growth. Collaborate with Store Support Center partners to ensure effective communication, issue resolution, and execution of company priorities. Serve as a key voice of the field by providing insights and recommendations that support continuous business improvement. Minimum Requirements Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent combination of education and experience. 5+ years of progressive multi-unit retail leadership experience in a high-volume, fast-paced environment. Proven track record of driving sales growth, operational excellence, and profitability across multiple locations. Demonstrated success leading, developing, and coaching field leadership teams. Strong financial acumen with experience managing P&L performance and business analytics. Experience leading through change and executing large-scale operational initiatives. Strong communication, relationship-building, and influencing skills. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and other business systems and reporting tools. Ability to travel extensively throughout the assigned region. Preferred Qualifications Discount retail, grocery, convenience, big box, or specialty retail experience preferred. Experience managing large geographic territories and complex multi-unit operations. Proven ability to build high-performing teams and develop future leaders. Strong understanding of merchandising, inventory management, asset protection, and workforce planning. Start Rate = $135,000-$160,000 based on experience plus bonus and equity. The company offers Health, Dental, & Vision, a flexible spending account, life and disability insurance benefits, a 401k plan, PTO, paid holidays annually, and an employee stock purchase plan. Your Perks and Benefits Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage Employee Assistance Program (EAP) Retirement Plan with Company Match Employee Stock Purchase Plan Educational Assistance Program Paid Time Off Associate Discounts and PerkSpot Program Career Growth and Leadership Development Opportunities And more! title: Senior Data Analyst - Dow Jones Energy Product Management
jd_text: Job Description: About the Team: Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition. Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets. About the Role: This is an exciting time to join our small but growing Commercial Product Management team where you will be supporting a number of key sectors including: Energy & Feedstocks, Coal, Metals and Mining, Renewables & Clean Energy and Chemicals. We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Data Analyst to support business performance, revenue management, customer analytics, sales operations, product strategy, and executive decision-making. The position requires a combination of advanced Excel, SQL, Python, business intelligence, financial analysis, data visualization, and strong business judgment. You will work across large and complex datasets to develop reporting, dashboards, analytical models, and actionable insights for product and leadership teams. You are comfortable working independently on ambiguous analytical problems, reconciling data from multiple sources, automating recurring processes, and communicating findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You will also serve as a key analytical partner to the Product, Sales, Finance, Customer Care, Consulting, and leadership teams. You will report to the Vice President - Product Management. You Will: Commercial & Revenue Optimization: Own end-to-end reporting for the Book of Business (ACV, renewals, new business, win/loss), building bottoms-up financial models, scenario analyses, and churn diagnostics to drive pricing, budgeting, and revenue retention strategies Advanced Data Engineering & SQL: Query, transform, and aggregate complex datasets across multiple source systems using title: HP EPIC Nursing Informatics Analyst III
jd_text: Where compassion meets innovation and technology and our employees are family. Thank you for your interest in joining our team! Please review the job information below. The Epic Nursing Informatics Analyst will have primary responsibility for the design, build/configuration, testing, validation and ongoing support of their assigned Epic application(s). The Analyst will be responsible for obtaining and maintaining in-depth knowledge of the software functionality and acquiring/utilizing knowledge of the operational workflows to be implemented with the Epic system. The Analyst will be responsible for coordinating aspects of planning, design, development, training, implementation, communication, maintenance and evaluation of existing or new functionality related to Epic and related information systems. May require participation in on-call rotation including weekend and after-hours coverage. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES - 1. Understanding of the organization, users and workflow in the analyst’s assigned area. 2. Ability to lead meetings, prioritize, resolve conflicts, manage issues, oversight and implementation of project plans. Work with Epic TS and related Epic Application Analysts to manage complex issues and optimization. 3. Ability to probe for information about the underlying needs of the organization and user community, which directly influences how the system will be built. 4. Thoroughly review, analyze and test every system change; follow proper change control processes. 5. Assists in the development, implementation, education, evaluation, maintenance and coordination of Epic and related applications. 6. Assists with and/or develops tip sheets or training documentation for new, or changes to current, workflows; communicate with department leadership and application users any specific information related to their application. 7. Maintain an Epic user web account to access group discussions, white papers, training documents, new version training material and release notes. Attends webinars, seminars and workshops to learn about new developments and changing technology trends; may participate in testing new vendor provided software in a test environment for possible use by the health system. 8. Maintain contacts with Epic partner and related vendors; attend product demonstrations, user group meetings, Epic sponsored webinars, and/or arrange to acquire and install system upgrades. 9. Performs other related work as required. KNOWLEDGE SKILLS AND ABILITIES Must be knowledgeable of new trends in electronic health record use and Epic applications and be able to apply that knowledge to their assigned area and the Epic system as a whole. Understand the importance of responsiveness in all situations and act accordingly. Utilizes the knowledge and skills of supported area to determine practical functions that are suitable for Epic applications. Assists in the development, implementation, education, evaluation, maintenance and coordination of Epic applications. Researches the implementation of Epic applications to assess effectiveness and satisfaction to ensure patient confidentiality and system security. Assists in development and organization of Epic educational training programs. Assists others in developing criteria for application, development, project planning, hardware, and consulting services evaluation and selection of Epic applications. Must possess the ability to operate a personal computer, file server, and host computer. Must be able to think logically in abstract symbolic terms; communicate effectively, both orally and in writing including providing technical information in non-technical terms; maintain detailed and accurate records; establish and maintain effective working relationships with those contacted in the course of the work. EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE - • National specialty certification attempt within three (3) to five (5) years. • Successfully complete Epic certification(s) in their applicable area within 90 days of class attendance. 8 years professional experience BS in Nursing and master's in nursing or clinical informatics preferred. Licensed as a Registered Nurse in the state of Texas. Management is typically the next higher level.
